about.heading: Profile
about.description_1: I am a vulnerability researcher working across software / firmware / hardware. I discover vulnerabilities, investigate their root causes and impact, and develop exploits to validate them in real environments.
about.description_2: I currently research zero-day vulnerabilities and offensive automation at Out of Bounds. At Pwn2Own Ireland 2026, I successfully exploited Philips Hue Bridge Pro as part of Out of Bounds. I contributed to the discovery of 18 CVEs in smart devices and worked as a Red Team intern at AUTOCRYPT’s Vehicle Threat Research Lab. At AutoHack 2025, I received the COSS Council Chair Award.
about.description_3: I am also interested in using AI agents to automate security research. My work includes Automated Exploit Generation and Automated Post-Exploitation, which automates follow-up attacks after initial access.
